output.summary: A shrub or tree native to the Americas from Mexico to Argentina, including parts of the Caribbean, it has fragrant white flowers and firm yellow fruit. Fruit flavour varies from bitter or tart and strawberry-like to sweet enough for some varieties to be eaten raw; it is also used for preserves.
output.edibilityNote: Some varieties bear sweet fruit eaten raw; the fruit is also made into preserves, though other varieties taste tart or bitter.
